options: 按資源地址、檢查ID與證據欄位比對，不只比較總數；敏感plan欄位在交付前遮罩。

steps.instruction:
把未知值當安全會漏報尚未解析的設定；plan檔與實際要套用的來源版本不符也使審查無效。
對照「計畫與來源契約」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。新的高影響缺口應阻擋，既有例外需獨立管理；本課交付審查結果不執行apply。

Treating unknown values as safe misses unresolved settings; a plan from another source revision invalidates review.
Against the nominal Plan-source contract result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Block new high-impact gaps and manage baseline exceptions separately; this course reviews plans without applying them.
Reverify this criterion: Link source configuration, resolved plan and policy results, reviewing creates, updates and deletes separately.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Treating unknown values as safe misses unresolved settings; a plan from another source revision invalidates review.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Plan-source contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付基線與計畫摘要、4個新增缺口、3個修復證據及未解析欄位清單。
在交接件中加入「計畫與來源契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：把原始設定、解析後計畫與政策結果連結，針對新增、更新、刪除分別審查。

steps.instructionEn:
Deliver baseline and plan digests, four new gaps, three remediation records and unresolved-field inventory.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Plan-source contract: Link source configuration, resolved plan and policy results, reviewing creates, updates and deletes separately.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Link source configuration, resolved plan and policy results, reviewing creates, updates and deletes separately. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。把原始設定、解析後計畫與政策結果連結，針對新增、更新、刪除分別審查。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Link source configuration, resolved plan and policy results, reviewing creates, updates and deletes separately.
